sources.title: Cogito AI — Your Desktop AI Hub. Free Models, Your Keys, Zero Limits.
sources.snippet: Cogito comes in two flavors — a polished graphical app for visual workflows, and a lightning‑fast terminal version for power users. Same engine, same models, same unlimited access. From code audits to crypto analysis, every task runs through a sleek, fast interface. Type your intent — Cogito handles the execution, turning complex prompts into immediate results.
